steps.name: Run the selected dependency-bounded correctness suites
Qualify the genuinely narrow reverse-dependent fixture
steps.run:
packages="$(python3 - <<'PYCODE'
from tools.ci_profile import classify_paths
from tools import ci_suite_inventory as registry
state = classify_paths(['crates/latent-state/src/lib.rs'])
assert state.profile == 'full' and state.renderer
identity = classify_paths(['crates/latent-identity/src/lib.rs'])
assert identity.profile == 'full' and identity.renderer
selection = classify_paths(['crates/latent-workflows/src/lib.rs'])
assert selection.profile == 'full' and not selection.renderer
assert selection.fast_packages
assert set(selection.fast_packages) < set(registry.load()['fastPackages'])
# Production dependency closure remains full; the controlled graph
# separately proves the preserved offline fast-profile selection.
from tools.tests.test_ci_suite_inventory import qualify_narrow_fixture
qualify_narrow_fixture()
print(selection.outputs()['fast_packages'])
PYCODE
)"
python3 tools/ci_fast.py --packages-json "$packages" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-fast/narrow"
